a.lede: Some of the most impressive tech that Adobe showcases at its annual Max conference each year is the experimental features it's developing, and the latest of those tools are being announced today: they can transform images into explorable 3D scenes, design AI characters by talking to them, and turn photo editing into a copy/paste process. a.title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters

b.title: Adobe Firefly AI Assistant can now take on recurring tasks for you
